reasoning: The complete bipartite graph K_{6,6} with partitions {0,1,2,3,4,5} and {6,7,8,9,10,11} is a maximal triangle-free graph on 12 vertices. It is triangle-free because it is bipartite (no odd cycles). It is maximal because adding any edge between two vertices in the same partition (the only missing edges) immediately creates a triangle: if u and v are both in partition A, then any vertex w in partition B forms the triangle u-w-v since both u and v are connected to all of B.
